name: Whistle air
joins: Engine room: Working-air receiver → PIP-10 → NLT-09
what it is: From the working-air receiver in the engine room, up the pipe trunk, to the whistle valve over the helm and on up the mast to the two horns.

name: Window wash
medium: fresh water from the pressure set
joins: Crew accommodation, bridge deck: Cold fresh-water main, bridge deck → PIP-11 → PIP-12
what it is: A branch of the cold fresh-water main to the valve in the console, and from there through the port cant and round the bay outside, under its sill, to a nozzle at each wiper.

name: Fire main branch to the bridge deck
what it is: A branch of the fire main up the house side to the hydrant on the port wing.

name: Scupper, port wing
joins: PIP-05 → Passenger deck: Overboard, port side
what it is: From the wing's deck down the house side and overboard above the waterline.

name: Scupper, starboard wing
joins: PIP-06 → Passenger deck: Overboard, starboard side
what it is: From the wing's deck down the house side and overboard above the waterline.

name: Refrigerant lines
medium: refrigerant, a liquid line and a suction line, insulated
what it is: Between the room unit and the condensing unit above it.

name: Condensate drain
what it is: From the room unit through the house side to the starboard wing's deck, and so to its scupper.
